Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase as the Australian players make their way out. The are followed by the two New Zealand openers, Martin Guptill and Tim Seifert make their way out to the middle. Jhye Richardson to start with the ball. Here we go...
... THE CHASE BEGINS ...

Right then! The target for New Zealand is a massive 209 runs. They have the batting who can chase it down. Cna they do it tonight? Australia on the other hand would be happy with their effort with the bat and now would look to their bowlers to get them a win here. All action for the chase coming up on the other side of the break.

Glenn Maxwell is down for a quick chat. He says that it was ugly at the start but the plan was to clear the ropes later on. Tells the pitch was a bit slow and inconsistent. Tells Sodhi made it a little harder. Adds the more a batter stays out in the middle it gets easier. Maxwell says that Finch has been hitting the ball well and it was good. Tells he is an important player and the skipper. Maxwell feels if they hit the top of the stumps they can do it.

New Zealand's bowlers were good with the ball as Southee and Boult began on the right note. Jamieson and Sodhi too were good but the disappointing thing for them was James Neesham who was clobbered for 60 runs in his 4 overs. He was carted for 28 runs in one over by Maxwell. In the end, a couple of wickets for Sodhi and a wicket each for Boult and Southee summed up the bowling for New Zealand.

Having put into bat, Australia lost Wade early. But then an 83-run stand between Finch and Philippe steadied the ship as well as laid a platform for them before Philippe departed. Finch though continued to play his shots as he brough his fifty. He along with Maxwell stitched a 64-run stand as Maxwell just took 25 balls to bring up his fifty. Both departed in quick succession but not before putting Australia in command there. In the end Marsh and Stoinis finished the innings for them.

Briliant finish from Australia sees them end really strongly. A sheer batting carnage from them. First it was Finch who brought up his fifty to get back to form. Then it was the Big Show who lit up the empty stadium with his batting.
Yorker to finish the innings. It is on off, Stoinis jams it out to the off side and gets a single. A very good final over. Just 8 off the final over. AUSTRALIA FINISH WITH 208/4!
EDGED AND FOUR! Does not matter how it comes. Length ball outside off, Stoinis swings but gets an outside edge. Luckily it goes away from short third man and to the fence.
Length ball on off, Marsh can just push it to cover for a single.

IN THE AIR AND DROPPED! Conway does well to get to the ball but cannot hold onto it.  Outside off, Stoinis swings but gets it off the outer half of his bat. The ball flies towards cover. Conway at sweeper cover picks it up late as he is slow to come off his line. He runs in and puts a dive. Hre gets his hands to it but cannot hold onto it. Single taken.
Swing and a miss! Outside off and fuller. Stoinis swings but cannot get anything on it.
On off, Marsh can just play it to long off for a run.
Slapped but the fielder at long off does well. Full around off, Marsh hits it hard but the fielder at long off runs to his right and keeps it down to one.
Good length ball around off, Stoinis dabs it to third man and rotates.
On the pads, Marsh flicks it through the leg side and gets three as Ish Sodhi does well to clean it up before the ropes.
Slower delivery outside off. Marsh looks to smack it on the off side but gets an edge which does not carry to the keeper.
Dot ball and that is worth golddust! On off and very full. Marsh cannot get it away.
On off, Stoinis taps it towards cover and takes a single as Mark Chapman is quick to get to the ball and release a good throw.
Who comes out to bat now? It will be Mitchell Marsh with the bat as Australia look for a final finishing touch to their innings.

OUT! CAUGHT! Southee has the last laugh as the Big Show is over. End of a fantastic knock from Maxwell. An absolute carnage of an innings. An anticlimatic end to it but that is what you get from Maxwell. Full around leg, Maxwell looks to play the reverse hit ver third man. The ball though hits his pad, then lobs off his bat behind the stumps. Tim Seifert comes running in and dives with the gloves on to take a good catch.
Yorker on leg, Maxwell looks to jam it out but gets hit on the ankle.
SIX! KAWABANGA! This is smoked again! Full on middle and off, Maxwell gets on his back foot and deposits it into the empty stands over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Nicely bowled but Maxwell still gets two. Yorker on leg, Maxwell squirts it through square leg and gets a couple as the fielder cleans it up.
FOUR! The Maxwell carnage continues! Slower delivery bowled into the surface. It is short and wide, Maxwell hangs on his back foot and slams it over point for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery around off, Stoinis runs it down to third man and gets off the mark with a single.
SIX! 28 runs off it! A strong over and this also means Australia on acceleration mode! Short of good length and around off, Maxwell pulls it handsomely up and over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! That brings up his fifty! Just 25 balls for him! Fuller and around off, Maxwell drives it uppishly towards point. The ball goes for a boundary this time.
FOUR! Maxwell is on the charge there! Length and around off, Maxwell lofts it over the bowler's head for another boundary.
FOUR! 14 from the 3 balls! Length and around off, Maxwell lofts it over mid on and gets a boundary as the fielder there cannot cut it off.
SIX! Crunched! Slower short ball around off, Maxwell waits on the back foot before pulling it over deep mid-wicket for half a dozen.
FOUR! Powered away! Short of good length and outside off, Maxwell throws his bat at it and sends it to deep point for a boundary.
Flatter outside off, Stoinis slaps it to cover-point.
Marcus Stoinis joins Glenn Maxwell out in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finch tries to showcase that he too can hit the Maxwell way but departs! Floated around middle, Finch goes for the reverse hit this time. He ends up hitting it in the air towards short third man where Kyle Jamieson does not move an inch as he pouches it. A body blow for Australia as Finch was looking in great touch.
Fuller outside off, Maxwell goes for the revese hit again but does not get the connection right as the ball goes off the pads towards short third man. A leg bye sneaked.
SIX! Maxwell in the groove here! Switch hits on display! Tossed up around leg, Maxwell switches his stance and then pulls it over third man for a maximum.
Loopy ball outside off, Maxwell lines up for a big hit but gets beaten there.
Fuller outside off, Finch drives it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Sodhi to bowl out. 1/25 from his 3 so far. Can he finish off well?
SIX! This time the Big Show connects! Short again from Southee, Maxwell waits for the ball to come before pulling it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Maxwell is turning it on here.
Short and around off, Maxwell now tries to take it on but the ball goes over him and into the mitts of the keeper.
WIDE! Full and down leg, Maxwell lets it be. Wide called.
Another short one around off, Maxwell tries to do the same thing as he did on the previous ball but this time he misses it.
FOUR! Maxwell is getting funky here! Short of good length around middle, Maxwell reverse hits it up and over short third man for a one bounce into the fence there.
Length and outside off, Maxwell tries to lay bat on ball but is beaten cmpletely.
FOUR! That is brutal! Short of good length from Southee, Maxwell waits for it to come before powering it over short third man. The ball runs to the fence there for a boundary.
Southee is back! 0/9 from his 2 overs.
FOUR! Third hit from Finch in the over. Short of good length and outside off, Finch rocks on the back foot and then punches it through point for a boundary.
Length and around middle, Maxwell tucks it to backward square leg for a single.
Length ball around off, Finch drives it to covers for a single.
Fuller around off, Finch drives it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Now Aaron gets it on the other side of the wicket. Short and around middle, Finch pulls it flat and towards deep square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Rammed away! Short and wide to start from Boult as Finch cuts it through point. The ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Boult is back! 1/19 from his 2 overs so far.
FOUR! All the good work from Neesham goes down the drain. Fuller and around leg, Maxwell glances it fine down to fine leg as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
And another dot! Short and around off, Maxwell hangs on the back foot as he looks to power it over the leg side but bails out at the last instance this time.
Another swing and a miss! Good length around middle, Maxwell makes room and looks to hit it over the bowler but is beaten again as the ball bounces over the stumps this time.
Play and a miss! Length ball outside off, Maxwell looks to go downtown but is beaten all ends up there.
Mishit but safe! Length and around off, Maxwell lofts it over mid on. There is not timing on it as it drops in the long on area. Two runs taken.
Full on off, driven down to long off for a single.
Change in bowling! James Neesham returns! 25 off his 2 overs so far.
Fuller on off, driven down to long off for a single.
Flatter outside off, Finch cuts it to dee point for a brace.
SIX! Reverse hit and Finch is back in form. Floated on leg, Finch goes for the reverse hit as he nails it over covers for half a dozen. He knows that the task is half done and he needs to continue.
NO BALL! A high full toss from Sodhi, Maxwell hits it over mid on for a single. Free Hit coming up.
Flaoted around off, slapped to covers for a single.
When its Maxwell it has to be innovation. A leg-break outside off, Maxwell goes for the reverse hit but ends up hitting it past  the keeper and towards short third man. A single taken. Byes called.
Floated around off, Finch punches it off the back foot for single.
On the pads, Finch flicks it through square leg and takes a run. He will keep the strike.

In the air but falls short. Misfield as well. Full around off, Finch looks to clear mid on but it comes off the lower part of his bat. It falls short of Boult at mid on. The odd bounce sees the ball go behind Boult. He recovers well to save it before the ropes. Two taken.
Short around off, Maxwell punches it behind point for a run.
Fullish ball on off and middle, Maxwell stays leg side of the ball and pushes it to cover.
Length ball around off, Finch cuts it to deep point for a single.
Glenn Maxwell is off the mark! Good length ball around off, Maxwell dabs it to third man and gets a run.
Who will walk out to bat at number 4? Big Show, Glenn Maxwell walks out to the tunes of Crank It Up.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another mishit and this time Guptill succeeds in taking it. Sodhi strikes at a crucial point as this partnership was getting on. He tosses one up and wide outside off, Josh Philippe had to reach to the ball as he gets it off the lower part of the bat. The ball goes to wide long off where Guptill runs across, slides and takes it inches above the ground.

Another lofted hit and Philippe is safe. Tossed up around off, Philippe goes for a hit over extra cover but ends up hitting it in the 'V'. The ball drops in between Long on and long off. A brace taken once again.
Flatter outside off, Josh looks to cut it but is beaten on the outside edge this time,
Floated around middle, Finch slogs it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller on off, driven down to long off for a single.
Good length and around off, cut through point for a single.
Another lofted mishit and Josh is safe once again. He lofts this fuller one towards deep mid-wicket but it falls short of the fielder. Another couple results.

In the air... Safe. Kyle bangs one short and around middle, Philippe goes for the pull but gets it off the higher part of the bat towards mid-wicket. It falls short of the converging fielders there. A couple taken.
Short of good length and on middle, Finch tucks it to the leg side for a single.
Another inside edge and another batsmen is safe. Fuller and around off, Finch looks to drive it through the off side but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a brace.
FOUR! Great shot! Full and in the slot for Finch to go over the off side as he lofts it over covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Boundary off the first ball of the over is always good. Full and around off, Finch lofts it off the inner half of the bat towards long on as the ball beats the man there for a boundary.
Change in bowling. Change of ends for Kyle Jamieson!
Fuller one around off, Aaron pushes it to covers and takes a single. 7 from Sodhi's first over.
Floated around off, Finch drives it to covers for a couple.
Sodhi continues to be short and wide as Josh cuts it to deep covers for a single.
Another flatter one from Sodhi as Finch slaps it to covers for a single.
Philippe looks to cut it but inside edges it to square leg for single.
Fuller on off, driven to long on for a single.
Spin time! Ish Sodhi is introduced into the attack for the first time this evening.
Lucky escape! Slower and fuller around off, Josh looks to drive it through the off side but ends up inside edging it past the stumps towards fine leg. A couple taken.
FOUR! Hammered away! Full and around off, Philippe throws his arms at it as he lofts it over extra cover for another boundary.
FOUR! That went like a rocket! Short and width on offer as Philippe latches onto it and then cuts it to deep point for a boundary. 50-run stand is up between these two.
Slower and shorter around off, Josh pulls it to deep square leg. Just a couple off the Free Hit.
Another back of a length ball outside off, Finch frees his arms as he cuts it to deep cover. A single taken. Hang on. Neesham has overstepped and it is a No Ball. Free Hit coming up.
Fuller in length and around off, Finch stays back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Short of good length and outside off, Josh cuts it to deep point but only for a single this time.
Swing and a miss! Short ball outside off, Finch looks to pull but misses. 9 off Jamieson's first! End of the Powerplay. Australia are 47/1 at the end of the first phase.

In the air but in no man's land. Length ball around off, Josh Philippe swings across the line. He gets a top edge. Luckily for Philippe, it falls between the keeper, who is running behind, and third man who is coming running in. Single taken.

Good running! Length ball on off, Finch taps it to cover and takes a quick run. Glenn Phillips has a shy at the keeper's end but misses. Even if he had hit, Josh Philippe is too quick and would have made his ground.
A huge cry of wait on from the Australian skipper. Good length ball around off, Finch punches it to cover.
FOUR! Good shot and Finch is starting to get into his groove now! Full on middle and off, Finch smokes it over mid on for a boundary.

Nice shot but does not have the legs! Jamieson starts with a fuller delivery outside off. Philippe drives it through extra cover. The ball does not have the legs to reach the fence. The batters take three.
Change from both ends. Kyle Jamieson to bowl the final over of the Powerplay!
On a length and around off, Finch takes it to covers. A dot is what they get.
Length and around off, Finch cuts it to point.
Good length and around off, Finch comes down the track as he looks to whip it around the corner but once again he misses it to get rapped on the pads.
FOUR! A mishit but it fetches runs. Full and around off, Finch goes for a lofted hit but mistimes it. Still it has enough power to beat mid on and races to the fence for a boundary.
Good length and around off, Finch comes down the wicket and looks to clip it ut he misses it to get rapped on the thigh pad.
SIX! This should ease the nerves for Finch! Length and around off, Finch lofts it up and over mid off as he fetches a maximum.
Change in bowling. First one ad it sees James Neesham replaces Tim Southee!
Length ball on off, Philippe tucks it to mid on.
FOUR! Clipped away! Full and around middle, Philippe clips it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full on off, Josh lofts it over mid on this time for a couple of runs. Lack of timing means that the ball does not go for a boundary.
Good length and around leg, Josh looks to tuck it to the leg side but is beaten to take the blow on the pads.
SIX! helped on! Full and around leg, Phillipe clips it to deep square leg for a maximum.
Length and on middle, Josh clips it to mid-wicket. A couple taken as the fielder mop it up in the deep.
Good length and around off, Philippe tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Length and around off, Finch this time gets his bat and pad close as he pushes it to mid off for a single.
FOUR! That is a safe shot! Length ball around off, Finch skips down the track, gets under the ball and then chips it over mid off and into the fence at long off for a boundary.
Good length and around off, Josh pushes it to covers for a single.
Nearly chops it on! Fuller and around off, Philippe looks to cut it but underedges it past the stumps and towards short third man.
BEATEN! Beautiful seam presentation. Length and around off, Josh looks to block it off the back foot but is beaten by the away movement on the ball.
Good length and around off, Finch pushes it to cover-point. A good over from Boult there.
In the air... Just past the diving cover. Length and around off, Josh drives it uppishly towards covers. The ball just evades the diving cover fielder. A single taken as Philippe gets off the mark.
Good length and sliding across Philippe, Josh makes a leave.
Josh Philippe walks out at number 3!.

OUT! CAUGHT! Boult gets his first and what a ball this is. A loose delivery first up followed by some real gems! Good length ball pitching just outside off. Wade looks to drive it on the up on the off side but the ball shapes away and catches the outside edge. It goes to the right of slip. Guptill there is safe a house and he takes a good catch.

Excellent comeback from Boult! He hits the deck hard and makes the ball shape away and bounce. Wade is caught in two minds, whether to go forward or stay backward. He manages to sway his bat away from the line.
FOUR! Crunched! First boundary of the game and it comes off Boult's first ball. Boult starts with a full ball wide outside off, Wade slams it through covers and gets a boundary.
Boult time! Trent Boult to share the new ball with Southee.

Another appeal and the umpire is once again unmoved. Full and around off, Finch looks to flick it away but gets it off his pads to the leg side. Southee appeals once again but the umpire shakes his head. New Zealand too don't take the review.
Good length and around off, Finch drives it to mid off.

NOT OUT! UMPIRE's call saves Finch there. Length ball around middle, Finch shuffles across to whip it to the leg side but he misses it to get rapped on the pads. There is an appeal from Southee but the umpire shakes his head. New Zealand take the review as the replays roll in. Ultra Edge shows that there is no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows that it is Umipre's call on hitting the stumps. Finch survives.

Review time! An inswinger has once again troubled Aaron Finch. There is an appeal for a LBW but the umpire is unmoved. Kane Williamson has taken it upstairs. Let's see whether the replays save the Australian skipper.
Fuller on middle, Wade sweeps it to fine leg for a single. Wade is off the mark here.
Fuller on off, Wade drives off the inner half and to the left of Southee who fields it in his followthrough.
Good length and around off, Wade tucks it to mid-wicket and shouts a loud 'Wait on'.
WIDE! Southee starts with a fuller one but it is well wide of off, Wade makes a leave. Wide given. Australia are underway.

We are all set to begin the game. The New Zealand players after a word from their skipper spread out onto the field. The two Australian openers, skipper Aaron Finch and Matthew Wade walk their way out to the middle. Tim Southee to start the proceedings with the ball. Here we go...

Devon Conway is up for a chat. He mentions that he is really excited. He mentions that a couple of good partnerships and taking responsibility helped them. He mentions that Australia is a good team and they respect that. He further says that he just tries to bat throughout the game and tries to adapt as per the situation. Mentions that Santner is an experienced campaigner for them but hopes that Mark Chapman would do a decent job for them in the middle.

Pitch Report - Craig McMillan is down for the pitch report. He mentions that it is overcast. Rebecca Rolls joins him and says that the pitch took a little bit of turn in the last game when the New Zealand womens played against the England Womens. She further says that the short boundaries on one side helps in chasing. She mentions that the key here is to bowl full with short boundaries at one end. Further mentions that Santner is a key white ball cricketer for New Zealand but also mentions that Mark Chapman would do good. In the end, Craig McMillan mentions that there is a bit of uncertainity over the surface so they would look how it plays during the game.

Marcus stoinis is down for the chat. He mentions that if feels a bit disappointed to not get over the line in the last game. He mentions that he tries to get himself him before playing his shots. He mentions that he is enjoying his batting and mentions that they are confident to win the game here and then win the last two too. Further says that there is no dramatic change expected in their approach.

Australia (Playing XI) - Matthew Wade (WK), Aaron Finch (C), Josh Philippe, Mitchell Marsh, Glenn Maxwell, Marcus Stoinis, Ashton Agar,Riley Meredith (DEBUT, IN FOR DANIEL SAMS), Jhye Richardson, Kane Richardson, Adam Zampa.

Australian skipper, Aaron Finch, says that he was looking to bowl first as well as the pitch seems to be hard underneath and there is moisture on top. Tells they improved from game 1 to game 2 and that is what they can expect. Informs Riley Merideth is making his debut and he replaces Daniel Sam

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Tim Seifert (Wk), Kane Williamson (C), Devon Conway, Glenn Phillips, James Neesham, Mark Chapman (IN FOR MITCHELL SANTNER), Kyle Jamieson, Tim Southee, Ish Sodhi, Trent Boult.

New Zealand skipper, Kane Williamson says that they will bowl. He mentions that the surface is the reason that they want to bowl. He further mentions that the pitch would stay same for the entire game. Further says that Mitchell Santner won't be playing tonight.

TOSS - It's time for the flip of the coin as the two captains in the company of Match Referee are out in the middle. Williamson being the home skipper gets to flip the coin. Up it goes as Finch calls it wrongly. NEW ZEALAND WILL BOWL FIRST!

FYI - Team update coming from the New Zealand camp is that Mitchell Santner won't be a part of today's game as he has woken up with head-cold. To add to it he has self-isolated himself as he awaits his Covid test results. For cover, New Zealand have added Adam Milne in the squad.

Time for action in the 3rd T20I between Australia and New Zealand. The hoṣts are leading the 5-match series by a margin of 2-0. If the first win was a comprehensive one then the second was a close one as New Zealand prevailed with consistency in both games. If the visitors are to be talked about then they have been beaten due to their underperforming top order. Australia's skipper has failed to lead by example with the bat. The series is in line for them as they look to sort out their opening combo woes. While his counterpart would look for another complete performance from his side as they look to seal the deal. Australia's bowling has been good but lack of run containing at the death has put additional pressure on their batsmen. We hope to get a competitive game as the toss and team updates come your way shortly.
